_meta.name: Smart contract bug hunt (public sample)
_meta.description: Public SAMPLE: 3 contracts with planted bugs; score = severity-weighted findings. Real sets stay private.

checklist.finding: Reentrancy in withdraw: external call before the balance is reduced
setOwner has no access control: anyone can become owner
sweep authorises with tx.origin, which is phishable
Spot AMM reserves used as price oracle: manipulable with a flash loan
Return value of token.transfer is not checked
set_price has no access control: anyone can set any ticket's price to zero
Overpayment above the price is kept and never refunded
An already-owned ticket can be bought again, overwriting the owner
